parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The partition name. Fuzzy match is supported. This parameter is valid only for MaxCompute tables.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort direction. Default value: Asc. Valid values:


- Asc: ascending order.
- Desc: descending order.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. Default value: CreateTime. Valid values:


- CreateTime: the creation time. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
- ModifyTime: the modification time. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
- Name: the name. This is the sort method used for HMS tables.
- RecordCount: the number of records. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.
- DataSize: the storage size. Only MaxCompute tables are supported.

parameters.name: TableId
parameters.description: The ID of the table. You can obtain this value from the response of the [ListTables](~~2880092~~) operation. For more information, see [Metadata entity concepts](~~2880092~~).
